classes.name: BRepProj_Projection
classes.summary: The Projection class provides conical and cylindrical projections of Edge or Wire on a Shape from `TopoDS`. The result will be a Edge or Wire from `TopoDS`.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Makes a Cylindrical projection of Wire om Shape.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Makes a Conical projection of Wire om Shape.

instanceMethods.name: IsDone
instanceMethods.comment: returns False if the section failed

instanceMethods.name: Init
instanceMethods.comment: Resets the iterator by resulting wires.

instanceMethods.name: More
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if there is a current result wire.

instanceMethods.name: Next
instanceMethods.comment: Move to the next result wire.

instanceMethods.name: Shape
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the complete result as compound of wires.
